name: Calligraphic flourish fills the pause
looks: A single pen line draws itself across the cream ground in dense, looping calligraphic flourishes, never resolving into legible words, filling the space between two quieter type beats with a sense of a hand at work.
build: One long SVG path with many control points, `strokeDashoffset` drawn from full length to 0 over roughly 2s as one continuous gesture; thin monochrome stroke matching the body type colour.
sound: A very soft pen-on-paper scratch, rising and falling with the line's speed.
prompt: Between two quiet type beats, draw a single continuous pen line in dense looping flourishes across the frame, never resolving into legible words, as a textural pause that feels handmade.
